single_method_lane.title: Wavenumber-Domain Baranov Pseudogravity-to-Gravity Poisson Phase Dislocation, Multiscale Upward-Continuation Sub-Alluvial Dip-Worm Tomography & Hydrothermal Demagnetization Conduit Specialist (PSGV-20)
single_method_lane.mechanism: Computes exact 2D cosine-tapered FFT Baranov pseudogravity integration g_psg(x) = F^-1{(|k|^2 + k0^2)^(-1/2) F{RTP}(k)} on USGS GeoDAWN Reduced-to-Pole magnetics (B02 rtp) so magnetic and isostatic gravity (B13 iso_grav_anom) share identical potential-field derivative order under Poisson's relation. Across unfaulted plutonic/volcanic contacts, density and magnetization step in phase (grad g_iso || grad g_psg); across hydrothermally altered blind geothermal fault damage zones, ascending 150-280 C fluids oxidize ferrimagnetic magnetite (Fe3O4 -> Fe2O3/FeS2) while preserving the horst/graben density step, creating local Poisson admittance collapse, quadrature phase dislocation, and 1st-vertical-derivative demagnetization troughs. Paired with exact 2D FFT multiscale upward continuation U_h (h = 200, 600, 1400, 2800 m) dip-worm persistence and up-dip surface-trace extrapolation (z_base / tan 60 deg) to z = 0, plus heterogeneous LightGBM + HistGradientBoosting 3-specialist distance-adaptive Log-Odds Product-of-Experts over cached PHYS-44 and HGVC-20 stacks.
named_non_fault_mimics: Reversely magnetized unfaulted Miocene volcanic mesa rims (e.g., Steens/Lovejoy basalt flows with Koenigsberger ratio Q > 1 producing negative RTP over high-relief bedrock plateaus with near-zero depth_to_base_surf)
Unfaulted granitic/metamorphic batholith contacts where density and magnetization step collinearly (cos(phi_grav - phi_psg) ~ +1)
Closed-basin playa evaporite brines and Pleistocene Lake Lahontan/Bonneville tufa shorelines
